A wind turbine has blades, which sweep out an area of diameter 25 m.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
The wind is blowing directly towards the wind turbine at a speed of 12 m / s. At this wind
speed, 7500 kg of air passes every second through the circular area swept out by the
blades.

parts.label: i
parts.text:
Calculate the kinetic energy of the air travelling at 12 m / s, which passes through
the circular area in 1 second.
kinetic energy =  ................................................ [3]

parts.label: ii
parts.text:
The turbine converts 10% of the kinetic energy of the wind to electrical energy.
Calculate the electrical power output of the turbine. State any equation that you
use.
power =  ................................................ [3]
